profile.highSchoolName: Hyper-competitive STEM magnet (top 1% class rank context)

rationale.intuition: Conflicting signals: GPA 3.5 在 MIT (admit middle 50 ~3.9-4.0) reads weak BUT 'top 1% class rank' + grade-deflated HS + USAMO + USACO Platinum 都表明 GPA underrepresents academic strength. MIT admissions officers explicitly read GPA in HS context: USAMO Qualifier at deflated-grade magnet typically means 'A in hardest possible courses, school does not grade-inflate'. 真实 industry 区间 5-18% (lower than typical strong unhooked due to GPA conservatism but higher than 3.5 baseline due to spike + context). Engine 当前: gpa 3.5 在 MIT 触发 gpaCompetitivenessComponent 负向修正, 但 class rank 不在 ProfileInput, gradeInflation='DEFLATED' 是否被 highSchoolContextComponent 识别 不明确. 0.04 下界让 engine GPA-penalty 落得很低; 0.20 上界反映 spike + context 应有的真实 lift.

sources.name: MIT Admissions Blog 'Things We Look For' 2023
sources.evidence: 'We read transcripts in the context of the school they came from. A 3.5 from a magnet school known for grade deflation may signal stronger academic ability than a 4.0 from a school where 80% of students earn straight As'

sources.name: MIT Class of 2028 Profile
sources.evidence: Middle 50 GPA 4.0 unweighted; ~5% of admits have unweighted GPA <3.7, indicating contextual reads do happen

sources.name: Crimson Education 'GPA-vs-Rank Conflicts' 2024
sources.evidence: Across T5 admits with GPA 3.4-3.6 from grade-deflated magnets: median admit rate ~15% (vs ~3% for same GPA from regular HS); spike + context combo critical

wontFix.reason: Class rank is not in ProfileInput; highSchoolGradeInflation='DEFLATED' may or may not flow through highSchoolContextComponent depending on whether engine reads that subfield. Conflicting GPA / class-rank / grade-inflation signals are the textbook 'context matters' admissions case, but engine currently leans heavily on raw GPA via gpaCompetitivenessComponent.
wontFix.followUp: Add classRank field to ProfileInput; expand highSchoolContextComponent to factor gradeInflation when computing gpaCompetitivenessComponent (e.g. DEFLATED + spike profile → reduce GPA penalty). Track via 'context-aware GPA' PR series.
